Claire — thanks for sending these over and for the clear packaging. Quick answers from procurement/payops side: 

- Remittance: we prefer a dedicated remittance email + PO number on the invoice. Please send remits to finance@tidaltech.com and include the PO in the invoice header field labeled "PO#". Our AP system will match on exact PO string.

- ACH format: CSV is easiest for our intake tool (columns we map below). We can accept NACHA if you require it, but please include a CSV sample for mapping. Suggested mapping:
  - invoice_number
  - invoice_date
  - amount
  - currency
  - po_number ("PO#")
  - remit_to_email

- Activation: standard play is vendor record creation + two micro-deposits to confirm account ownership (2 small amounts < $0.50). Micro-deposit verification usually takes 48–72 hours from initiation. After verification we lift the "pending" flag and can schedule the first ACH.

Notes: do NOT paste full bank account numbers in unencrypted email. We can accept a redacted bank letter (last 4 OK) or a bank-signed PDF — the one you attached looks good but our vendor onboarding requires the issuing bank letter to include a dated signature.

Next steps from our side
- Marissa will open the vendor record and request any outstanding fields.
- Jonas will take the mapping sample once you send the CSV and confirm transform rules.

If you can send a CSV sample and confirm whether the W9 is the most current version, we’ll queue this for activation.

Thanks,
David
Head of Finance Integrations, Redwood Inference
+david.kim@redwood.com
